mapper.insert: insert into basket_match_data_audit (match_id, submission_id, data_version, audit_type, audit_action, before_status, after_status, submitter_id, submit_time, audit_status, auditor_id, auditor_name, audit_time, audit_remark, reject_reason, prev_audit_id, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{matchId}, #{submissionId}, #{dataVersion}, #{auditType}, #{auditAction}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{submitterId}, #{submitTime}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditorId}, #{auditorName}, #{auditTime}, #{auditRemark}, #{rejectReason}, #{prevAuditId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.update: update basket_match_data_audit set audit_status = #{toStatus}, auditor_id = #{auditorId}, audit_time = now(), audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and audit_status = #{fromStatus} and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select m.id as matchId, m.match_no as matchNo, m.season_id as seasonId, s.season_name as seasonName, m.stage_id as stageId, st.stage_name as stageName, m.group_id as groupId, g.group_name as groupName, ht.team_name as homeTeamName, at.team_name as awayTeamName, m.home_score as homeScore, m.away_score as awayScore, m.match_status as matchStatus, m.data_status as dataStatus, m.scheduled_start_time as scheduledStartTime, m.update_time as submitTime from basket_match m left join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = m.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_tournament_stage st on st.id = m.stage_id and st.is_delete = 0 left join basket_tournament_group g on g.id = m.group_id and g.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team ht on ht.id = m.home_team_id and ht.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team at on at.id = m.away_team_id and at.is_delete = 0 where m.is_delete = 0 and m.season_id = #{seasonId} and m.stage_id = #{stageId} and m.group_id = #{groupId} and (m.home_team_id = #{teamId} or m.away_team_id = #{teamId}) and m.data_status = #{dataStatus} order by m.update_time desc, m.id desc
select * from basket_match_data_audit where match_id = #{matchId} and audit_type = #{auditType} and audit_status = 'PENDING' and is_delete = 0 order by id desc limit 1

select id, submission_id as submissionId, audit_action as auditAction, before_status as beforeStatus, after_status as afterStatus, audit_status as auditStatus, auditor_id as auditorId, auditor_name as auditorName, audit_time as auditTime, audit_remark as auditRemark, reject_reason as rejectReason from basket_match_data_audit where submission_id = #{submissionId} and is_delete = 0 order by create_time desc, id desc
